description: Header file defining mock asynchronous proxy resolver classes and factory for testing proxy resolution in Chromium project.

classes.name: MockAsyncProxyResolver
classes.description: A mock asynchronous proxy resolver for testing, handling proxy resolution requests asynchronously.

classes.description: Represents a proxy resolution job, allowing manual completion.

classes.description: Implementation of ProxyResolver::Request for mock resolver.

classes.description: Represents a request to create a proxy resolver, reference-counted.
